title: fix: use mainHelper consistently
body:
This PR has been extracted from changes in https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch/pull/5123, where they were unrelated and added a bit of noise.

This has the side effect of fixing an issue related to current refinements not respecting facet values order (see [this comment](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch/pull/5123/files/f2f2248f8c09a4543f88189cdfac9b16bc5d5d1c..9e2318636873b6d5def2a1d7992ccdf1f3926568#r1340100492)).
